title: MSFS 2024 Sim Update 3 ✈️ | Build 11 Bug Fixes & Regression Patch Breakdown!
description:
Hey pilots! 🧑‍✈️ Buckle up as we cruise through the latest Sim Update 3 for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024, spotlighting Build 1.5.15.0. While it’s a smaller update, it brings essential bug fixes and regression patches that are sure to smooth out your flying experience. 🛠️
We’ll cover every fix in the release notes, including improvements to cockpit placement, towplane spawning, and some quirky regressions like that wild drone mode activation. Plus, SDK developers get a small win with WASM tweaks!

🚀 Highlights from the Update:
📏Cockpit size & placement now save properly
🪝Towplane reliably spawns
🚫Rare waypoint altitude crash eliminated
🪟 Popout windows working again
🛸 Drone mode bug squashed
✈️ PC-24 passenger door walkaround fix
🔒Locked presets now show a popup
🖥️ SDK: WASM system reload bug fixed

Even modest updates like this one help keep the skies smooth and the experience immersive. Got thoughts on this patch or issues that still linger? Drop a comment and join the conversation! 👇
